title: Can You Do the ELVIS Lip Without Squinting? 😏
description:
Curl up one side of your lip like Elvis and keep that eye open. It squints anyway, right? The muscle that lifts your upper lip starts right beside your eye, and doctors think the order to lift spills over into the eye's own squeeze muscle. In one study of 89 healthy adults, 90 in 100 squinted on the snarling side. Did your eye squint?

Subscribe for a new strange question every day.

Next up: can you swap thumb and pinky? 👍

Sources: Citron et al., Facial Plastic Surgery & Aesthetic Medicine, 2022 (89 adults); Raman et al., Journal of Craniofacial Surgery, 2025 (50 adults); Radiopaedia, levator labii superioris alaeque nasi.
